title: The cerebellum is nonconscious because it is invisible to EEG

statements.text: The cerebellum shows oscillations and local field potentials but is invisible to EEG and MEG, so its information is not broadcast into the brain's global field, which accounts for its activity being nonconscious. No calculation of $\Phi$ has ever been made for the cerebellum.

sources.quote: The key finding is the invisibility of the cerebellum in EEG or MEG measurements
No actual calculation of Φ has ever been attempted for the cerebellum
